options: A physical quantum computer built by IBM
An open-source Python SDK for building, compiling, and executing quantum circuits
A cloud subscription service that sells quantum processing time only
A hardware description language for designing superconducting chips
questions.explain: Qiskit is software — a Python SDK that handles circuit construction, compilation (transpilation), and execution. It is not itself a quantum computer; it's the layer you use to talk to one, or to a simulator.

options: `qiskit-aer`
`qiskit-ibm-runtime`
`qiskit` (the core package)
`qiskit-algorithms`
questions.explain: The core `qiskit` package holds the circuit-building and compilation machinery — `QuantumCircuit`, gate definitions, and `transpile`. The other packages are separate, focused add-ons.

questions.q: Why did functionality that used to live in `qiskit.algorithms` move to a standalone package like `qiskit-algorithms`?
options: IBM discontinued algorithm support entirely
As part of the Qiskit 1.0/2.0 reorganization, the project split the large bundled package into focused pieces, moving algorithm building blocks out of core
Algorithms were merged permanently into `qiskit-aer`
It was a temporary bug that has since been reverted
questions.explain: Qiskit 1.0 and 2.0 split what used to be one large bundled package into core (`qiskit`), simulation (`qiskit-aer`), hardware access (`qiskit-ibm-runtime`), and separate community/algorithm packages.

questions.q: Which package would you need only once you're ready to run a circuit on real IBM quantum hardware, not for local simulation?
options: `qiskit`
`qiskit-aer`
`qiskit-ibm-runtime`
None — all packages are required for every circuit
questions.explain: `qiskit-ibm-runtime` is the client library for IBM's cloud hardware and managed execution primitives. Local simulation only needs `qiskit` and `qiskit-aer`.

questions.q: What does the line `qc = QuantumCircuit(1)` actually do?
options: Runs a one-qubit circuit on real IBM hardware immediately
Allocates one qubit and creates an empty circuit object with no gates applied yet — no simulation or execution occurs
Simulates the circuit on AerSimulator and returns measurement counts
Installs the qiskit-aer package
questions.explain: This line only describes a circuit — one qubit, zero gates so far. It's pure circuit construction, the first of the three jobs Qiskit does; no simulation or hardware execution has happened at this point.
